Agent Name: Orchestrator
, Step Number: 13
, Reason for Mistake: Proposed a class composition that violates the puzzle’s constraints: it relies on a single Mage to cover both Fire and Ice (implicitly using two Mages earlier, breaking the “all classes are unique” rule), and it fails the “two plate wearers” requirement (only Paladin is plate in their set). Choosing Demon Hunter for Metamorphosis also blocks the consistent solution that uses Frost Death Knight (ice) and Warlock (Metamorphosis/fire), with Druid as the bear and Paladin/Priest as holy tank/healer, which fits all armor and ability clues.
